name: RollCapture
description:
[Wiki Page](https://wiki.roll20.net/Script:RollCapture)

Generic roll result extraction for Roll20. Listens to roll template messages, extracts values per configurable rules stored in handouts, and fires character abilities with captured values.

Features:
- Configurable capture rules via handouts tagged [RollCapture] or [RC]
- Conditional extraction (when/default blocks)
- Formulas: direct value, max(), min(), sum(), choose() (GM prompt)
- Character ability firing: rc_any, rc_<rollname>, rc_default
- onCapture API for programmatic consumers

**v1.1.0 - New features:**
- ScriptKit integration: help, man, whatsnew, motd, gen-help, gen-dev-docs

Commands:
- `!rollcapture status` -- Show loaded rules, callbacks, pending choices
- `!rollcapture rules` -- List all loaded rule handouts
- `!rollcapture rule <name>` -- Open or create a rule handout
- `!rollcapture dissect` -- Arm next roll for field inspection (shows all template fields)
- `!rollcapture reload` -- Reload rules from handouts
